title: 第7章 石猴故事第8章 出手提示
slug: 长生从守书阁的太监开始
lines: 他从石猴出世、发现水帘洞自称美猴王讲起，讲到猴王为求长生，漂洋过海寻仙访道，终在灵台方寸山、斜月三星洞拜得菩提祖师为师，得名孙悟空，并学会了七十二般变化和筋斗云的神通。
李叶青口才本就不差，又刻意渲染那神通变化的奇妙、筋斗云一个跟头十万八千里的逍遥，直听得莲公主美目圆睁，时而惊叹，时而向往。
“……那猴王回到花果山，剿了欺压孩儿们的混世魔王，又觉手中缺件趁手兵器，便依老猴之言，径入东海龙宫，索要宝贝。”
李叶青讲得兴起，将孙悟空龙宫借宝，强行取走天河定底的神珍铁——如意金箍棒的过程描绘得活灵活现，“那宝贝，重一万三千五百斤，却能大能小，悟空耍弄一番，小可如绣花针藏于耳后，大则可顶天立地，直搅得东海龙宫天翻地覆，龙王敖广叫苦不迭！”
“好！这猴子果然厉害！那龙王也忒小气！”莲公主听得拍手称快，全然代入其中。李叶青见效果甚好，便继续往下讲龙王与悟空结怨，上天庭告御状，玉帝采纳太白金星招安之策，封孙悟空为“弼马温”。
讲到悟空得知官职卑小，怒反天庭，打出南天门，回山自称“齐天大圣”时，莲公主更是兴奋得脸颊微红。
“……玉帝闻奏大怒，即派托塔天王李靖，携哪吒三太子，点起三军，下界擒拿妖猴！这才引出一场——大圣轮棒斗天神，哪吒挥剑战妖王的浩大场面！”
李叶青恰到好处地在此处停下，做出一个手势，微微喘息。
莲公主正听到兴头上，见没了下文，急得站起身“后来呢？那孙悟空打赢了吗？哪吒厉害还是猴子厉害？你快讲啊！”
李叶青面露难色，恭敬道“公主，今日天色已晚，这‘大闹天宫’一段故事颇长，小的若一口气讲完，只怕误了公主回宫的时辰，若是被皇后娘娘或是陛下知晓公主在书阁逗留太久，小的……小的实在担待不起。”
他这是以退为进，既吊足了莲公主的胃口，又显得自己谨守本分，关心公主安危。
莲公主虽不尽兴，但看了看窗外渐暗的天色，也知李叶青所言在理。
她撅了噘嘴，但还是说道“好吧，今日便到此。
不过，这故事还没完，我明日……不，后日再来听！
你若敢忘了后续，或者讲得不好，我定不饶你！”
说着，她眼珠一转，又看向桌上那本《幽明杂录》“这本书，我先拿去瞧瞧，看看还有没有类似的有趣故事！”
说罢，再次如一阵风般，拿起书便从窗口掠了出去，留下清脆的笑声。
李叶青望着她消失的方向，长长舒了一口气，背后竟已惊出一层细汗。与这位心思跳脱、地位尊贵的公主周旋，简直比解析十本典籍还要耗费心神。
“没想到小太监你煮茶的手艺也这么好。”
莲公主捧着素瓷茶杯，指尖感受着恰到好处的温热。
“跟着书中学的。”李叶青拨弄着红泥小炉里的炭火，跳跃的火光将他白净的侧脸映得泛红。
“是吗？”莲公主挑眉，轻轻啜饮一口。
茶汤入口清润，带着似有若无的花果香，让她眼睛一亮。
“要是再有些点心配着就更好了。”
“公主说笑了。”
李叶青依旧垂着眼，“宫里除了膳时，只有膳房能起明火。就这煮茶的小炉，还是托了您的福才敢点上的。”
莲公主嘴一瘪，故作不悦，可上扬的嘴角却藏不住笑意“小太监你这人好生没趣，一句玩笑话也当真。”
“公主明鉴，”李叶青声音平稳，“小的本就是无趣之人。”
“哦？”莲公主向前倾身，衣袖带起一阵淡香，“可无趣之人，怎会想出《西游释厄传》这般精彩的故事？”
“不过是多读了几本杂书，偶然看到，拾人牙慧罢了。”
“不对吧？”
莲公主眼中闪过狡黠的光，“我特地问了翰林院十几位老先生，竟无一人听过这故事。你上次说是在前朝古籍上看到的——那书叫什么名字？”
她微微扬起下巴。看你还怎么编！
content_en:
He started with the birth of the Stone Monkey and discovered the Water Curtain Cave and claimed to be the Monkey King. He also told how the Monkey King traveled across the ocean to seek immortality in order to seek immortality. Finally, he became the disciple of Patriarch Bodhi at Lingtai Fangcun Mountain and Xieyue Sanxing Cave, and was named Sun Wukong. He also learned the magical power of seventy-two transformations and somersault clouds.
Li Yeqing's eloquence was not bad at all, and he deliberately exaggerated the wonder of the magical changes and the freedom of the somersault cloud, which made Princess Lian's beautiful eyes widen, sometimes in wonder, sometimes in yearning.
"...The monkey king returned to Huaguo Mountain and defeated the demon king who oppressed the children. He felt that he was missing a weapon, so he followed the old monkey's advice and went into the East China Sea Dragon Palace to ask for the treasure."
Li Yeqing was so excited that he vividly described the process of borrowing the treasure from Sun Wukong's Dragon Palace and forcibly taking away the Ruyi Golden Cudgel, the sacred iron that anchors the bottom of the Tianhe River. "That treasure weighs 13,500 kilograms, but it can be big or small. Wukong played with it, and the small one is like an embroidery needle hidden behind the ear, and the big one can stand up to the sky and the earth. It turned the East China Sea Dragon Palace upside down, and the Dragon King Ao Guang complained endlessly!"
"Okay! This monkey is really powerful! That Dragon King is so stingy!" Princess Lian clapped her hands and took in the whole situation. Li Yeqing saw that the effect was very good, so he continued to talk about the grudge between the Dragon King and Wukong, and went to heaven to complain. The Jade Emperor adopted Taibai Jinxing's strategy of recruiting peace, and named Sun Wukong "Bima Wen".
When it was said that Wukong learned that his official position was low, he rebelled against the Heavenly Court, broke out the Nantian Gate, and returned to the mountain to call himself the "Monkey King", Princess Lian's cheeks turned red with excitement.
"...The Jade Emperor was furious when he heard the report, so he sent Li Jing, the king of the tower, and the third prince Nezha to mobilize the three armies and capture the demon monkey in the lower realm! This led to a huge scene - the great sage fought the gods with a wheel and stick, and Nezha wielded his sword to fight the demon king!"
Li Yeqing stopped here at the right time, made a gesture, and breathed slightly.
Princess Lian was getting excited when she heard nothing more, and stood up anxiously, "What happened next? Did Sun Wukong win? Is Nezha more powerful, or is the monkey more powerful? Tell me quickly!"
Li Yeqing looked troubled and said respectfully, "Princess, it's getting late today. This 'Havoc in Heaven' story is quite long. If I finish it in one breath, I'm afraid I'll miss the time for the princess to return to the palace. If the Queen or Your Majesty knows that the princess has stayed in the library for too long, I... I really can't bear it."
He was retreating in order to advance, which not only whetted Princess Lian's appetite, but also showed that he was sticking to his duty and caring about the princess' safety.
Although Princess Lian was not happy, she looked at the darkening sky outside the window and knew that what Li Yeqing said was reasonable.
She pouted, but still said, "Okay, that's it for today.
However, this story is not over yet. I will listen to it tomorrow... no, the day after tomorrow!
If you dare to forget the follow-up, or if you don’t speak well, I won’t forgive you! "
As she said that, she rolled her eyes and looked at the book "Youming Miscellaneous Records" on the table. "I'll take this book and have a look first to see if there are any similar interesting stories!"
After saying that, like a gust of wind, he picked up the book and swept out of the window, leaving a crisp laugh.
Li Yeqing looked at the direction in which she disappeared and breathed a long sigh of relief. A thin layer of sweat broke out on his back. Dealing with this thought-provoking and noble princess is simply more energy-consuming than analyzing ten classics.
"I didn't expect you, little eunuch, to be so good at making tea."
Princess Lian held the plain porcelain tea cup and felt the right warmth on her fingertips.
"Learned from the book." Li Yeqing fiddled with the charcoal fire in the small red clay stove, and the dancing light of the fire made his fair side face turn red.
"Really?" Princess Lian raised her eyebrows and took a sip.
The tea soup was clear and moist in the mouth, with a vague fragrance of flowers and fruits, which made her eyes light up.
"It would be better if there were some snacks to go with it."
"Princess is joking."
Li Yeqing still lowered his eyes, "In addition to meals in the palace, only the dining room can light an open fire. This small stove for making tea is only possible because of your blessing."
Princess Lian frowned, pretending to be displeased, but the raised corners of her mouth couldn't hide the smile, "Young eunuch, you are so boring, and you take every joke seriously."
"Princess Mingjian," Li Yeqing said in a steady voice, "I am a boring person by nature."
"Oh?" Princess Lian leaned forward, carrying a light fragrance on her sleeves, "How could a boring person come up with such a wonderful story as "Journey to the West"?"
"It's just that I read a few more miscellaneous books and accidentally saw it, which I picked up on others' wisdom."
"Isn't it right?"
A cunning light flashed in Princess Lian's eyes, "I specifically asked a dozen old gentlemen in the Hanlin Academy, but no one had heard of this story. Last time you said you saw it in an ancient book from the previous dynasty - what was the name of that book?"
She raised her chin slightly. Let’s see how you make it up!
